verdict.rationale:
Terraform's state model and reusable modules (terraform-docs-13, terraform-docs-20, terraform-docs-6) imply that environment isolation is achievable via separate workspaces/state, and the CLI probes confirm plan/apply/destroy work cleanly per state file (terraform-probe-6, terraform-probe-8). However, the pack lacks any explicit documentation of the `terraform workspace` command, workspace-scoped variables, or a directory-per-environment pattern that developers commonly use for dev/staging/prod separation.
missing for 10: explicit docs on `terraform workspace new/select`, guidance on separate state files per environment, and community validation that this pattern works well in practice.
